verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Tracing the red (DC) and green (AC) marked lines: they begin at the proposed PV array area on the terrace (pages 11-13), run along the parapet wall and down the exterior building wall through visible white PVC surface conduit with clip/tie points (page 14), continue down the wall (pages 15-16) to the Equipment Location room where DCDB/Inverter/ACDB (purple box) and Battery (green box) are marked (page 17), then the AC path continues to the meter panel termination point (page 18) and on to the Solar Meter slot beside the Main Meter (page 19). Each segment connects to the next without a visible gap or unexplained termination.
verdicts.rationale: The annotated cable-routing path is traceable continuously across all relevant captioned photos (Cable Routing, Equipment Location, Meter Box) with visible conduit at exposed sections and no orphan ends, though the annotations are schematic overlays rather than photographs of the actual physical cable runs (which are not yet installed at TSVR stage).
